command_or_procedure: Obtain service-owner approval for RPO and RTO objectives before declaring the failure boundary.
Provision an isolated production-like recovery target in a separately named cluster or fault domain without public application ingress.
Record latest recoverable data time and failure declaration time, then restore PostgreSQL and immutable object snapshots.
Deploy immutable API, worker, and consumer images, run authenticated data/application smoke, and record the application-restored time.
Run the reviewed rollback path, hash sanitized artifacts, and obtain independent reviewer sign-off after completion.
blocking_reason: No service-owner-approved RPO/RTO objective or separately provisioned production-like recovery target exists. The current single-node staging drill cannot prove fault-domain recovery or production availability.
prerequisites: Approve or replace the proposed RPO 300 seconds and RTO 1800 seconds before execution.
Provision a separately named recovery target outside the active single-node staging fault domain.
Assign an independent reviewer who is not the drill operator.
Issue time-bounded least-privilege database, object-store, registry, model, and cluster credentials.
limitations: This is a preflight plan and records no production RPO or RTO measurement.
The proposed objectives are recommendations, not approved service objectives.
Existing isolated staging recovery evidence remains valid only for its named single-node environment.
